items.headline: North Texas turns big plays into 49-39 win over Navy for 4th straight victory
items.description: — Dalton Carnes returned a punt 76 yards for a touchdown and Zakye Barker took a fumble 63 yards for another score in North Texas' 49-39 win over Navy on Saturday.

items.headline: Air Force: Service member died from fall before Navy-UTSA game
items.description: A member of the Air Force has died from his injuries after he fell while attempting to rappel from the rafters of the Alamodome during a pregame demonstration before UTSA's football game against Navy, the Air Force said.

items.headline: McCown throws for 359 yards, 3 TDs as UTSA beats Navy 38-34
items.description: — Owen McCown threw for 359 yards and three touchdowns, including a 41-yard touchdown pass to A'Marion Peterson with 2:24 remaining, to give UTSA a 38-34 victory over Navy on Saturday night.
